raw_manifest_json.TestingChangelog:
- Add the ability to limit how many panels/alerts can be displayed by a single burden. These settings are in a new "Advanced" tab under the burden name.
- Add the ability to set a wrap mode for the overlay. Setting the new "Layout Wrap" setting to "Wrap at size" allows specifying a size at which the layout will wrap onto a new line. The layout will wrap in the secondary direction specified in the Layout Direction.
- To support the above, added two new Layout Direction settings "Right (extending up)" and "Left (extending up)". Other layout directions were renamed to match this pattern.
